policy.pricing_text: FRAs at the 11 May close (1x4 3.90, 3x6 4.08, 6x9 4.36, 9x12 4.56 vs WIBOR 3M 3.85) price roughly 70bp of NBP hikes within 12 months. The MPC held at 3.75% on 6 May (core probably rose in April; wait-and-see); Glapiński (7 May): the probability of a hike has risen and a cut is very unlikely - a CPI breach of 3.5% with persistent forecasts would trigger action. April minutes (8 May): the war lifts CPI near term but weaker activity may curb medium-term pressure; Kotecki: forecasts keep CPI within target. April flash CPI 3.2% (30 Apr; 3.0% expected); core 2.7% in March. The fuel VAT and excise cuts run to 15 May.
policy.risk_text: Glapiński (7 May) moved to hike risk: a CPI breach of 3.5% with persistent forecasts would trigger action - May CPI (29 May) and the July projection are the tests. The front end trades oil and the Iran talks; long end: heavy May supply.

macro.projection_text: NBP March projection (4 Mar; data to 19 Feb, war excluded): CPI 50% bands 1.6-2.9% (2026), 1.1-3.7% (2027); central path 2.3% / 2.4% / 2.3% (2026-28), GDP 3.9% in 2026; IMF (14 Apr): 2026 CPI 3.3%. The July projection is the next marker.
macro.fiscal_text: 2025 general-government deficit 7.3% of GDP (GUS EDP, 22 Apr), debt 59.7%; 2026 deficit cap PLN 271.7bn; budget deficit after March PLN 69.6bn (25.6% of the limit); the fiscal notification and the government's assumptions put the 2026 deficit at ~6.8% of GDP; the SAFE loan was signed on 8 May; fuel package (VAT 8%, minimum excise, price caps) to 15 May.
macro.fiscal_risk_text: 2026 needs ~49% (after 28 Apr, MoF) financed; budget accounts ~PLN 184bn at end-April (MoF estimate); 8 May T-bill PLN 3.66bn at 4.151%. S&P affirmed A-/stable (8 May), DBRS A with a negative trend; Fitch A- and Moody's A2 have negative outlooks.
macro.backdrop_text: The NBP held at 3.75% on 6 May; April CPI 3.2% y/y; 2025 GDP 3.6%, Q4 4.1%. Ratings: Fitch A- negative, Moody's A2 negative, S&P A- stable (affirmed 8 May). 11 May: Trump rejected Iran's reply and POLGB yields rose 6-11bp ahead of MoF and BGK supply; MoF sold PLN 3.66bn of 46-week bills at 4.151% on 8 May (Millennium); DBRS kept Poland at A with a negative trend; ~49% of 2026 needs financed at end-April; Q1 wages +6.7% y/y (8.5% in Q4), below the NBP projection; Q1 GDP flash due 14 May. Abroad: Brent ~$104 after Trump said the truce is on 'life support'; gilt 10Y back to 5% on Starmer's crisis; at least two ECB hikes priced (June ~80%), ~31% for a Fed hike by March 2027; UST 10Y 4.40%.

calendar.plan_text: MoF May plan (30 Apr): sale auctions on 13 May (PLN 6-12bn), 21 May (7-13bn) and 27 May (6-12bn) in OK0129 (new 2Y, replaces OK0128), NZ0331, PS0731, DS0436 and NZ0936; a 46-week T-bill on 8 May (3-6bn); no switch. ~49% of 2026 needs financed after the April sales. 8 May T-bill: PLN 3.66bn at 4.151% plus 0.55bn.
calendar.timing_text: The Aug 2025-Feb 2026 pattern (auction-day close the cheapest point of the week) comes from a rally regime; March's sell-off broke it and April's auction days cheapened on average. Remaining May sales: 13 May, 21 May, 27 May. Next MPC 1-2 Jun: a hold is expected; the July projection is the next marker.

facts.core_text: Regime: deal hopes versus stalemate - oil swinging around $100-110; the NBP held at 3.75% on 6 May while FRAs price roughly 70bp of NBP hikes; the ECB is priced for a June hike, the BoE for hikes, the Fed has turned to hike risk, the CNB and MNB are on hold. Poland's 5Y CDS was 50bp and the 10Y spread to Bunds 268bp on benchmark bonds (Erste, 11 May close). Truce on 'life support'; Brent ~$104 (11 May).

quasi_takeaways: FPC fixed lines trade ~{lo}-{hi}bp over the POLGB curve (average {avg}bp); widest ASW {widest} at {widest_asw}bp. Same State Treasury guarantee as POLGBs.
Best pickup: {best} ({best_sp}bp vs POLGB). For buy-and-hold books the guarantee makes the pickup attractive; liquidity is the cost (Pekao became BGK market maker on 13 Nov 2025).
Supply: BGK sold PLN 0.69bn on 29 Apr plus 0.13bn additional (demand 0.94bn); next FPC tenders 14 and 28 May; the FWSZ 2026 bond plan was raised to PLN 76.6bn.
Use auctions, not Catalyst: trades are small retail lots and some lines go weeks without a print.
